name: trophy-backlog
description: A local-first personal PlayStation trophy backlog.

scripts.dev: concurrently --kill-others-on-fail --names api,web "npm run dev:api" "npm run dev:web"
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace apps/api && npm run build --workspace apps/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --workspace apps/api && npm run typecheck --workspace apps/web
scripts.production:restart: npm run production:stop && npm run production:start
